Changelog for 1.0.1

1.0.1 — Remove bootstrap-agent-quick.mjs from the published bundle.

The wrapper script was hardcoded to find scripts/bootstrap-agent.mjs at __dirname/../../../.. and only worked when invoked from inside the DashClaw repo itself. External consumers got "Bootstrap script not found" instead of any useful behavior, so the script never belonged in a public skill bundle.

ClawScan flagged it as ASI05 (Unexpected Code Execution) for shelling out to an unauditable project-root script with the consumer's API key. Cisco's skill scanner had flagged the same file as CRITICAL in March 2026 for the same reason. Removing it eliminates both findings.

Remaining scripts (diagnose.mjs, validate-integration.mjs) are read-mostly diagnostics that ClawScan rates as Notes only.

Initial release of DashClaw Platform Intelligence skill.

- Provides an expert snapshot of DashClaw's platform APIs, env vars, and database tables.
- Covers 184 active API routes across 49 categories.
- Lists 4 required and 120 optional environment variables.
- Details 73 database tables.
- Emphasizes live queries for the most up-to-date platform information.
- Includes structured API endpoint summaries for troubleshooting and integration.
